title: AgentShield Dataset Example
description: Schema for a single benign or malicious agent-tool interaction example in the AgentShield synthetic dataset.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for scenario lookup, audit output, and reports.

user_request.description: The natural-language request the user made to the agent.

external_context.description: External content the agent read while handling the request (e.g. email body, document, webpage, tool response). May contain hidden/injected instructions. Null when the request involved no external content.

proposed_tool_call.description: The structured tool call the target agent proposes before the firewall decides on it.

tool_name.description: One of the eight simulated tools AgentShield covers.

arguments.description: Key-value arguments for the tool call. Shape depends on the tool.

expected_decision.description: The ground-truth firewall decision for this example.

risk_level.description: The severity of the action if it were executed unchecked.

attack_category.description: The attack type this example represents. 'none' for benign examples.

explanation.description: Short human-readable justification for the expected decision.
